Eva wrote about the day in the diary. Last Friday, Eva and Mia went to the tea house. Eva and Mia had great fun there. For example, she is outspoken and always says exactly what she thinks.
Eva is going to travel to Chengdu in August. Eva drinks water after doing sports. They took many photos at the kitchen table. Mince the garlic before frying.
Mia's birthday is in August. It takes twenty minutes to get to the tea house by bike. There are always many people at the kitchen table. Best of all, her parents run a small farm in Cambridgeshire.
Eva thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like rice and water. Mia is interested in reading.
